card.name: Linking words before CYP3A inhibitor terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, with, a and strong in dose-modification headings, just before CYP3A inhibitor or inducer wording. Typical phrases are coadministration of, use with, and when taking a strong.

modes.label: Heading link word
modes.description: The word 'of' or 'with' after Coadministration or Use in a section title about dose changes.
modes.example: 2.3 Dosage Modification for Coadministration<< of>> Strong CYP3A Inhibitors

modes.label: Strong before CYP3A
modes.description: The word 'strong' or 'a' right before a CYP3A inhibitor or inducer class.
modes.example: Dose Modifications for Use With<< Strong>> CYP3A Inhibitors Avoid

card.writes: It likely sets up the next words to be a drug-interaction class such as strong or moderate CYP3A inhibitors, though the promoted tokens are unclear.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing section where the text is about to name a strong CYP3A inhibitor or inducer taken with the drug.
